framework.summary: Large frontier developers must write, follow and publish a frontier AI framework, and review it at least once per year.
framework.quote: A large frontier developer shall write, implement, comply with, and clearly and conspicuously publish on its Internet website a frontier AI framework

transparency_report.summary: Every frontier developer must publish a transparency report before or when it deploys a new or substantially modified frontier model; large developers add catastrophic-risk summaries.
transparency_report.quote: a frontier developer shall clearly and conspicuously publish on its Internet website a transparency report

incident_reporting.summary: Frontier developers must report critical safety incidents to the Illinois Emergency Management Agency and Office of Homeland Security within 15 days of discovery.
incident_reporting.quote: A frontier developer shall report any critical safety incident pertaining to one or more of its frontier models to the Agency within 15 days of discovering the critical safety incident.

imminent_risk_reporting.summary: An incident posing imminent risk of death or serious physical injury must be disclosed within 24 hours to an appropriate authority such as law enforcement.
imminent_risk_reporting.quote: poses an imminent risk of death or serious physical injury, the frontier developer shall disclose that incident within 24 hours

third_party_audit.summary: The framework must describe how the developer uses third parties to assess catastrophic risk; no independent audit is required.
third_party_audit.quote: using third parties to assess the potential for catastrophic risks and the effectiveness of mitigations of catastrophic risks

whistleblower.summary: The bill has no whistleblower protection.

registration.summary: The bill sets no registration or licensing requirement.

shutdown.summary: The bill requires no shutdown capability.

compute_threshold.summary: A frontier model is a foundation model trained with computing power greater than 1026 (as printed) integer or floating-point operations, including fine-tuning and reinforcement learning.
compute_threshold.quote: using a quantity of computing power greater than 1026 integer or floating-point operations

revenue_threshold.summary: A large frontier developer, with its affiliates, had annual gross revenues above $500,000,000 in the preceding calendar year.
revenue_threshold.quote: collectively had annual gross revenues in excess of $500,000,000 in the preceding calendar year

harm_threshold.summary: Catastrophic risk means death or serious injury to more than 50 people, or more than $1,000,000,000 in property damage, from a single incident.
harm_threshold.quote: more than 50 people or more than $1,000,000,000 in damage to, or loss of, property arising from a single incident

penalties.summary: Large frontier developers face a civil penalty up to $1,000,000 per violation, recovered only by the Attorney General.
penalties.quote: shall be subject to a civil penalty in an amount dependent upon the severity of the violation that does not exceed $1,000,000 per violation

effective_date.summary: The bill text states no effective date.

notes: Stored text shows the compute figure as '1026' (superscript lost; almost certainly 10^26). Closely tracks CA SB 53. Large FOIA-amendment tail of the text not relevant. Also requires large developers to send the Agency internal-use risk assessment summaries every 3 months (Sec. 10(d)). Sec. 30 creates an ILCompute consortium, outside the duty list.
